description: macOS app identities used by the execution-entry guard (detection-rules.md §4) and the paste guard allowlist (§5.3), same layout as windows.json. macOS has no window classes: the platform layer passes the frontmost app's bundle id as both `class` and `process`, and the window title (or empty) as `title`. Bundle ids are compared case-insensitively. Measured on macOS 27.2 for com.apple.Terminal, com.mitchellh.ghostty, com.apple.Passwords and com.apple.keychainaccess; the others come from each app's published Info.plist and still need checking on a machine that has them. dialog_class is the out-of-process Open/Save panel service; with no titles listed it never yields a file dialog (unverified whether it ever becomes frontmost).
